'''Reuss VIII''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. It was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] became a polluted industrial world. [[Torel Vorne]] was the most powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the planet.

The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet was full of toxins and [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]] from the industrial plants. Prolonged exposure to the atmosphere without a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] could cause permanent lung damage.

Medical Supervisor [[Sena Pakkallo]] served there briefly, providing hygiene instruction to locals.<ref name="TBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
